h1.en: Peristaltic pump illustrates the note on Diesel 60 Concrete Pump
h1.zh: 「蠕动泵」用来说明为什么柴油60型混凝土泵不印活塞行程

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a piston stroke, a cycle rate or a squeeze gap for the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump in Xingtai. The row does list Theoretical Output 35 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peristaltic_pump.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械没有在邢台的柴油60型混凝土泵这一行标出活塞行程、冲次或挤压间隙。这一行标出了理论输送量35 m³/h和最大出口压力30 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peristaltic_pump。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peristaltic_pump. The image subject is Peristaltic pump head. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a piston stroke, a cycle rate or a squeeze gap for the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump in Xingtai. The frame “Mobile crane” shows Grove mobile crane 450T, Brisbane and adds no stroke figure. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 100. It is not a measured stroke for Diesel 60 Concrete Pump.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peristaltic_pump。画面内容是Peristaltic pump head。河北品锦机械没有在邢台的柴油60型混凝土泵这一行标出活塞行程、冲次或挤压间隙。柴油60型混凝土泵这一行不会把那些名称变成扭矩、小时间隔，或这一行没有写出的材料牌号。管路长度仍要读这个型号自己的距离格，不读这一帧，也不读另一台泵。

body.en: The row does list Theoretical Output 35 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa. The wear-part list elsewhere names pistons and swing-arm parts as replacement sizes. Main-unit weight is 3500 kg. Theoretical Output 35 m³/h.
body.zh: 这一行标出了理论输送量35 m³/h和最大出口压力30 MPa。液压泵 Kawasaki double pump 100。

body.en: A piston displaces concrete into the line. a squeeze pump compresses a hose. This Diesel 60 Concrete Pump row does not turn those names into a torque, an hour interval or a material grade beyond what this row already lists. Subject: Grove mobile crane 450T, Brisbane. Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa.
body.zh: 画面「Mobile crane」的主体是Grove 汽车起重机 450T, Brisbane，也没有补上行程数字。主体：Grove 汽车起重机 450T, Brisbane。

body.en: The sheet does not choose between them by inventing a stroke. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. If a piston or valve is visible there, that is the subject of the frame. Pipeline length still has to be read from this model's own distance entries, not from the frame and not from a different pump.
body.zh: 另一份易损件清单用外径列出活塞和摆臂类替换件。如果画面里能看到活塞或阀，那只是这一帧的主体。

question.en: Does Diesel 60 Concrete Pump list a piston stroke?
question.zh: 柴油60型混凝土泵标出了活塞行程吗？

answer.en: No. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peristaltic_pump.
answer.zh: 没有。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peristaltic_pump画面里印出的数字。

question.zh: 那标出了什么工作参数？

answer.en: Theoretical Output 35 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peristaltic_pump.
answer.zh: 理论输送量35 m³/h，最大出口压力30 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peristaltic_pump画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. Hours, torque and price stay unprinted. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peristaltic_pump.
answer.zh: 没有。小时、扭矩和价格都没有标出。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peristaltic_pump画面里印出的数字。
